active_dataset_note: null is deliberate. This file carries every dataset row, so a default here is a silent answer to a question nobody asked -- it is what let five variation renders read the central campaign. Name a dataset explicitly: --dataset <key>, or HADRONIZATION_DATASET. Every row here stays selectable by name, including legacy_21_06_2026. Per-campaign selector files keep their own active_dataset and are unaffected.

hf_pt2_candidate.interpretation: HF_PT2 is a 3M-event pipeline-validation campaign, not physics. It is a canonical_candidate so the merge-consuming plotting path can be exercised end to end; publication_eligible is forced false and outputs must be regenerated from HF_RUN3_V1 before any paper use. The data routes are resolved through HADRONIZATION_DATA_ROOT by the selected site profile. It is NOT the active dataset: select it with DATASET_SELECTOR=config/dataset_selector_hf_pt2.json so the legacy regression default and its diagnostic target stay intact.

hf_pt2_int_candidate.interpretation: HF_PT2_INT is the 10M-event intermediate pipeline-validation campaign, not physics. It exists as a dataset row to discharge B6: the thnsparse and audit-subsamples plotting targets could not run at all because no hf_pt2_int dataset existed in either selector. It is a canonical_candidate so the merge-consuming plotting path can be exercised against a larger sample than HF_PT2; publication_eligible is forced false and outputs must be regenerated from HF_RUN3_V1 before any paper use. The data routes are resolved through HADRONIZATION_DATA_ROOT by the selected site profile. It is NOT the active dataset in the default selector: select it with DATASET_SELECTOR=config/dataset_selector_hf_pt2_int.json so the legacy regression default and its diagnostic target stay intact. Its merged directories are the ones first contact validated read-only: complete_root_HF_PT2_INT_MONASH and SUBSAMPLES_HF_PT2_INT/combined_root_subSamples_MONASH.

hf_run3_v1_candidate.interpretation: HF_RUN3_V1 is the physics campaign and the first dataset whose merged product declares analysis_schema paul_pair_objects_primary_ground_v3. SEALED AND AUTHORIZED 2026-08-17: status canonical, publication_eligible true, per docs/HF_RUN3_V1_PUBLICATION_AUTHORIZATION.md. All three tunes are merged (33/33 legs, one closure PASS each) and the freeze under HADRONIZATION_DATA_ROOT/project/runs/HF_RUN3_V1/freeze/ carries 3000 rows verified against the bytes on disk. The data routes are resolved through HADRONIZATION_DATA_ROOT by the selected site profile. The key retains the _candidate suffix deliberately: it is exported as HADRONIZATION_DATASET_ID and may appear in provenance already written, so renaming it would orphan those records -- the key is an identifier, status carries the claim.

hf_smoke3.interpretation: HF_SMOKE3 is a 600,000-event operations-certification campaign, not physics: three tunes, 10 jobs per tune, 20,000 requested successes per job. It exists to run generation, analysis, merge, freeze and plotting end to end from the rebuilt repository, whose planes until now rested on contract tests and on reuse of pre-rebuild bytes. Ten jobs per tune fill the ten file blocks exactly once (canonical_slot % 10, PRACTICE 5.1), which is the smallest exposure the canonical manifest will accept. It is a canonical_candidate so the merge-consuming plotting path admits it; publication_eligible is false and no authorization is cited, deliberately. PRACTICE 2.7 two-tier rigor applies: its numbers carry ordinary engineering care and no measurement discipline, and nothing derived from it may ever become publication-eligible. The data routes are resolved through HADRONIZATION_DATA_ROOT by the selected site profile. The combined selector names no default, so this dataset must be named: --dataset hf_smoke3, HADRONIZATION_DATASET=hf_smoke3, or the single-row file config/dataset_selector_hf_smoke3.json.

hf_sys_muf_down_variation.interpretation: HF_SYS_MUF_DOWN is a systematic variation of the sealed HF_RUN3_V1 physics campaign, at one tenth its exposure (10 M events per tune against 100 M). It exists to measure a systematic shift and is NOT a publication dataset: publication_eligible is false and no authorization is cited, deliberately. Its merged products carry three closure PASSes and 33 promoted legs. Added 2026-08-19 because the dataset selector, not the plotting configuration, is what the resolver reads -- see the run record's plumbing entry.
